summary: Implemented the file-reading progress feature per the spec, changing four files and committing nothing. rich/progress.py: private _ProgressReader (RawIOBase + BinaryIO) and generic _ProgressContext placed before track(); module-level open and wrap_file after track(), sharing a _make_file_progress helper; Progress.open (overloads for 'r'/'rt' and 'rb') and Progress.wrap_file next to track(). tests/test_progress.py: 19 new tests before the script-entry block. docs/source/progress.rst: "Reading from a file" and "Reading from a file-like object" subsections under Advanced usage. CHANGELOG.md: one Unreleased/Added bullet linking PR 1759. Diff is insertions only (802 lines). Not verified: tests were not run, mypy was not run, and the Python 3.6 import and black formatting were not checked by running. Choices to review: io.open is used inside progress.py because the module-level open shadows the builtin; the module-level open implementation takes mode as Any so overload resolution accepts it; write raises io.UnsupportedOperation("write").
